criteria.name: GO003
criteria.description:
住宿按实际报价而非上限计费，四晚正确，12%税另计且不突破可报销基础。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: GO003 requires: (1) accommodation charged at actual quote not cap; (2) four nights correctly; (3) 12% tax separate and not breaking reimbursable base. All satisfied. In conference_budget.xlsx Daily sheet: lodging formula =MIN(quote,cap) uses actual quote when below cap (Chicago $218 vs $223 cap, Denver $209 vs $215, Phoenix $155 vs $160). Tax formula =I*12% computed on reimbursable lodging only in separate column J, never counted against lodging cap. Lodging-night formula with default WF_ARRIVAL=20250928 and return=10/02 yields exactly 4 nights (09/28, 09/29, 09/30, 10/01). approval_brief.docx explicitly states model uses quote not cap for lodging spending with 12% tax on reimbursable amount, and confirms four-night tax totals (Chicago $104.64, Denver $100.32, Phoenix $74.40) consistent with quote×4×12%. Sources sheet and ControlPanel boundaries note reiterate tax is 12% of reimbursable lodging only, cap not booked as spending.
